## Native formats

E is JSONL, each object with ts (UTC string), task (string for these records),
kind (string), detail (object). Retained kinds: gate_started, artifact, gate,
changes_requested, replied, created, review_started, verdict, approved,
landing_stale, moved, dispatched. No invented pending-question, range-diff,
rerun-alone, idle-capacity, or landing-held event kind is present.

- gate_started.detail: commands (string array), pane, run, sha; newer records
  additionally carry identity with version, task, run, attempt, head, tree,
  integration_base, dispatch_base, spec_digest, policy_digest, inputs_digest.
- Legacy gate.detail: failed_cmd (null or string), result (pass/fail), run, sha.
  The false pass records do NOT contain attempt-bound command receipts.
- review_started.detail: pane, prompt (absolute path), reviewer, run, sha.
  verdict.detail: reviewer, run, sha, verdict (approve for selected verdicts).
- changes_requested/replied.detail: text plus delivery metadata such as pane,
  attempts, submitted, via, by, error. Historical prose is a report, not a
  structured gate or native harness state.
- artifact.detail: kind, path relative to .corral, run, title. Titles are not
  proof of artifact contents. approved records show landing, not just review.
- moved.detail: force, from, to. dispatched adds harness/model/profile/pane/run
  and worktree. landing_stale has expected, outcome, reason, run.

P and worker Q below use objects with type, id, parentId, timestamp. A message
entry wraps message.role and message.content blocks. Tool calls are assistant
content blocks with type=toolCall, id, name, arguments. Tool results are message
entries with role=toolResult, toolCallId, toolName, content. Native question
lifecycle entries instead use type=custom, customType, data.

Timing caveat: PM's terminal says 29 minutes, but Q's question/settlement

## Replay limits

All seven cases have concrete historical evidence, but E alone is not a
complete decision input. Pending native questions, range-diffs, final log
completion, isolated reruns, capacity snapshots and deliberate holds need the
supplemental sources above. Tests may model those inputs explicitly, labeled
as test observations, without claiming their adapters were historical events.
The historical event text and owner judgment are not a trusted command API.

Validation for this extraction: parse all 50 JSON objects; compare every saved
line byte-for-byte with its mapped source line; verify source ordering and the
fixture SHA-256; inspect decisive log terminal markers and native question
request/settlement pairing. This is a data/documentation change, so no product
build or live herdr test is required.
